title: Alder Gulch Short Line Steam Railroad Museum
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Original AGSL motive power was provided by a couple of coal-fired Davenport Dinky locomotives obtained from the Anaconda Company smelter in Great Falls. Both burned in an engine house fire in 1991. On July 31, 1999, Engine No.12 was delivered to the Alder Gulch by John Larkin of the Escanaba & Lake Superior Railroad.
